## About

C1.Win.Pdf library is an extention to ComponentOne Pdf library (C1.Pdf).
It provides additional APIs compatible with Windows Forms (WinForms) and
Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) 4.6.2 and above.

All features are fully supported on Windows, macOS and Linux.

C1.Win,Pdf provides a set of APIs that allow developers to implement fast and
efficient processing of PDF documents from other sources:

* Extended and Windows metafiles (*.emf and *.wmf files).
* XAML interface elements (for WPF only).
